text.description_html:
First Impressions 3452 Long Contemporary Stainless Steel Door Pull

This all new curved pull flows outward, away from the door. The center of the pull has approximately 4" of distance from the door and both ends of the pull approximately 1/2" distance. The warm Satin Stainless Steel finish resist finger prints for easy maintenance.

Long lasting stainless steel pull with a very clean contemporary design. Nice sized 1" diameter pull handle is easy to grab. Perfect for office entry doors, commercial store front doors, commercial appliance doors, just about anywhere a sleek long door pull is needed.

Specifications for the First Impressions CF-3452 Long Stainless Door Pull:

  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1"
  • Bracket Diameter: 1"
  • Total Projection: 5"
  • Material: Stainless Steel Tubing
  • Satin Stainless Steel Finish

Available in 4 standard lengths: The 6 foot long door pull is the most popular size.

  • FII-3452/36-US32D: Total Length 36" (3 Feet) - Center to Center Mount - 28-3/4"
  • FII-3452/72-US32D: Total Length 72" (6 Feet) - Center to Center Mount - 64"

    • Note: This beautiful door pull is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths up to 10 feet. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

    When Selecting a Mounting Hardware:

    • Thru-Bolted Mounting: Pull bolts through the door.
    • Surface Mounting: Pull screws to the face of the door.
    • Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Requires 2 pulls.

    Sold individually (1 door pull handle). If you order Back-to-Back Mounting please Order 2 Pulls.
